AutoAddTagEcs.description_en: Indicates whether to automatically add the public IP addresses of new ECS instances that match the tags to the address book. New ECS instances include newly purchased instances with the specified tags and existing instances whose tags are modified to match

CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示

Description.description_en: The description of the access control policy

DestPort.description_en: The destination port that is used in the access control policy
DestPort.description_zh: 访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口

DestPortGroup.description_en:
The name of the destination port address book.

port: Port

group: Port address book
DestPortGroup.description_zh:
访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口类型。取值：
port：端口

DestPortGroupPorts.description_en: The ports in the destination port address book
DestPortGroupPorts.description_zh: 目的端口地址簿中包含的端口

items.description_en: The port in the destination port address book
items.description_zh: 目的端口地址簿中包含的端口

DestPortType.description_en:

port: port

group: port address book
DestPortType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口类型。取值：

group：端口地址簿

Destination.description_en:
The destination address in the access control policy. The value of this parameter varies based on the value of DestinationType.

If the value of DestinationType is`net`, the value of this parameter is a CIDR block. Example: 10.0.3.0/24.

If the value of DestinationType is`domain`, the value of this parameter is a domain name. Example: aliyun.

If the value of DestinationType is`group`, the value of this parameter is the name of an address book. Example: db_group.

If the value of DestinationType is`location`, the value of this parameter is a location. For more information about the location codes, see AddControlPolicy. Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"].

If this parameter is omitted, all types of destination addresses are retrieved
Destination.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址。支持模糊查询。DestinationType（目的类型）不同，目的地址的取值也不同。

当DestinationType为`net`时，目的地址为CIDR格式的IP地址段。例如：10.0.3.0/24。

当DestinationType为`domain`时，目的地址为域名。例如：aliyun。

当DestinationType为`group`时，目的地址为地址簿的名称。例如：db_group。

当DestinationType为`location`时，目的地址为区域名称（具体区域位置编码请参见AddControlPolicy。例如：["BJ11", "ZB"]。

不设置该参数表示查询所有类型的目的地址

DestinationGroupCidrs.description_en: The CIDR blocks in the destination address book
DestinationGroupCidrs.description_zh: 访问控制策略中的目的地址簿中的网段

items.description_en: The CIDR block in the destination address book
items.description_zh: 访问控制策略中的目的地址簿中的网段

DestinationGroupType.description_en:
The type of the destination address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: an IP address book, which contains one or more CIDR blocks.

tag: an ECS tag-based address book, which contains the public IP addresses of ECS instances that have specific tags.

domain: a domain name address book, which contains one or more domain names.

threat: a threat intelligence address book, which contains one or more malicious IP addresses or domain names.

backsrc: a back-to-source address book, which contains the back-to-source IP addresses of one or more Anti-DDoS or WAF instances
DestinationGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。

tag：ECS标签地址簿，包含一个或多个ECS标签下的IP地址。

domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址。

threat：威胁地址簿，包含一个或多个恶意IP或域名地址。

backsrc：回源地址簿，包含一个或多个DDoS防护实例或WAF实例的回源地址

DestinationType.description_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block

group: destination address book

domain: destination domain name

location: destination region
DestinationType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
location：目的区域

Direction.description_en:
The direction of internet traffic. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic

out: outbound traffic
Direction.description_zh:
互联网流量方向。取值：

in：外对内流量访问控制
out：内对外流量访问控制

DnsResult.description_en: The result of the DNS resolution

DnsResultTime.description_en: The time of the DNS resolution, provided as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
DnsResultTime.description_zh: DNS解析的时间戳。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

DomainResolveType.description_en:
The DNS resolution method of the domain name in the access control policy. Valid values:

0: FQDN-based resolution

1: DNS-based dynamic resolution

2: FQDN-based and DNS-based dynamic resolution
DomainResolveType.description_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

FQDN：基于FQDN
DNS：基于DNS动态解析
FQDN_AND_DNS：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the policy validity period. This is a UNIX timestamp, accurate to the second. The time must be on the hour or half-hour and must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.

This parameter is empty if RepeatType is set to Permanent. It is required if RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly
EndTime.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间

GroupName.description_en: The name of the address book

GroupType.description_en:
The type of the address book. Valid values:

ip: IP address book

domain: domain address book

port: port address book

tag: ECS tag-based address book

allCloud: cloud service address book

threat: threat intelligence address book
GroupType.description_zh:
地址簿的类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿。

domain：域名地址簿。

port：端口地址簿。

tag：ECS标签地址簿。

allCloud：云服务地址簿。

threat：威胁情报地址簿

The unique ID of the address book.

This ID is required for other operations, such as deleting the address book. You can obtain the ID by calling the [DescribeAddressBook]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138869.html） operation
GroupUuid.description_zh:
地址簿的唯一标识ID。

删除安全访问控制的地址簿，需要提供该地址簿的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用[DescribeAddressBook]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138869.html）接口获取

HitLastTime.description_en: The time when the policy was last hit, provided as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
HitLastTime.description_zh: 最新命中时间戳。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

HitTimes.description_en: The hit count of the access control policy
HitTimes.description_zh: 访问控制策略的命中次数

4: IPv4

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the policy was last modified, provided as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 策略最后修改时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示

NatGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the NAT gateway

Order.description_en:
The priority of the access control policy.

The priority starts from 1. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Order.description_zh:
访问控制策略生效的优先级。

优先级数字从1开始顺序递增，优先级数字越小，优先级越高

The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

ICMP

TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY（表示所有协议类型）
不设置该参数表示查询所有协议类型

ReferenceCount.description_en: The number of policies that reference this address book

Release.description_en:
The status of the access control policy. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
Release.description_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略

false：不启用访问控制策略

RepeatDays.description_en:
The days of a week or month on which the policy recurs.

If RepeatType is set to Weekly, the valid values are 0 to 6. The week starts on Sunday.
If RepeatType is set to Monthly, the valid values are 1 to 31
RepeatDays.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期。
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，取值范围：0~6，每周开始于周日。
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，取值范围：1~31

items.description_en:
The day of a week or month on which the policy recurs.

If RepeatType is set to Weekly, the valid values are 0 to 6. The week starts on Sunday.
If RepeatType is set to Monthly, the valid values are 1 to 31
items.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期。
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，取值范围：0~6，每周开始于周日。
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，取值范围：1~31

RepeatEndTime.description_en:
The time when the policy stops to take effect. Example: 23:30. The time must be on the hour or half-hour and must be at least 30 minutes later than the recurrence start time.

This parameter is returned empty if RepeatType is set to Permanent or None. This parameter is required if RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly. The time is in the HH:mm format. Examples: 08:00 and 23:30
RepeatEndTime.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复结束时间。例如：23:30，必须为整点或半点时间，且大于重复开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间。
时间格式为HH:mm（24小时制），例如08:00、23:30

RepeatStartTime.description_en:
The time when the policy starts to take effect. Example: 08:00. The time must be on the hour or half-hour and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the recurrence end time.

This parameter is returned empty if RepeatType is set to Permanent or None. This parameter is required if RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly. The time is in the HH:mm format. Examples: 08:00 and 23:30
RepeatStartTime.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复开始时间。例如：08:00，必须为整点或半点时间，且小于重复结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间。
时间格式为HH:mm（24小时制），例如08:00、23:30

RepeatType.description_en:
The recurrence type of the policy. Valid values:

Permanent (default): The policy is always valid.

None: The policy is valid only once.

Daily: The policy recurs daily.

Weekly: The policy recurs weekly.

Monthly: The policy recurs monthly
RepeatType.description_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月

Source.description_en:
The source address in the access control policy. The value of this parameter varies based on the value of SourceType.

If SourceType is set to`net`, the value of this parameter is a CIDR block. Example: 192.0.XX.XX/24.

If SourceType is set to`group`, the value of this parameter is the name of a source address book. Example: db_group.

If SourceType is set to`location`, the value of this parameter is a location. For more information, see [AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html）. Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
Source.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的访问源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，访问源为CIDR格式的IP地址段。例如：192.0.XX.XX/24。
当SourceType为`group`时，访问源地址为源地址簿名称。例如：db_group。
当SourceType为`location`时，访问源地址为区域（具体区域位置编码请参见[AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html））。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]

SourceGroupCidrs.description_en: The CIDR blocks in the source address book
SourceGroupCidrs.description_zh: 访问控制策略中的源地址簿中的网段

items.description_en: The CIDR block in the source address book
items.description_zh: 访问控制策略中的源地址簿中的网段

SourceGroupType.description_en:
The type of the source address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: An address book that contains one or more IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

tag: An address book that contains the public IP addresses of ECS instances with specific tags.

domain: A domain name address book, which contains one or more domain names.

threat: a threat intelligence address book, which contains one or more malicious IP addresses or domain names.

backsrc: a back-to-source address book, which contains the back-to-source IP addresses of one or more Anti-DDoS or WAF instances
SourceGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。

tag：ECS标签地址簿，包含一个或多个ECS标签下的IP地址。

domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址。

threat：威胁地址簿，包含一个或多个恶意IP或域名地址。

backsrc：回源地址簿，包含一个或多个DDoS防护实例或WAF实例的回源地址

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: a source CIDR block

group: a source address book

location: a source region
SourceType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址类型。取值：

net：源网段（CIDR地址）
group：源地址簿
location：源区域

SpreadCnt.description_en: The number of specification units that the policy consumes. The value is calculated by using the following formula: Number of source addresses × Number of destination addresses × Number of port ranges × Number of applications
SpreadCnt.description_zh:
占用访问控制策略的规格数，即每条策略占用规格数的累加值。
单条策略占用的规格数 = 源地址个数（IP地址段个数或区域个数）* 目的地址个数（IP地址段个数或区域个数或域名个数）* 端口段个数 * 应用数

StartTime.description_en: The start of the policy's validity period, provided as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

TagKey.description_en: The key of the ECS tag

TagValue.description_en: The value of the ECS tag

TagRelation.description_en:
The logical relationship among multiple ECS tags. Valid values:

and: An ECS instance must have all the specified tags.

or: An ECS instance must have one of the specified tags
TagRelation.description_zh:
多个ECS标签间的关系。取值：

and：多个标签间为“与”关系，即同时匹配多个标签的ECS公网IP才会被加入地址簿。

or：多个标签间为“或”关系，即只要匹配一个标签的ECS公网IP就会被加入地址簿

VpcFirewallId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC firewall

AclAssessmentDetail.description_en: The assessment details of the access control policy

CheckName.description_en: The name of the ACL check

LastCheckTime.description_en: The time of the last check, provided as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
LastCheckTime.description_zh: 最近检查时间戳，单位：秒

RecordAssessmentDetail.description_en: The assessment details of the ACL check
RecordAssessmentDetail.example: It is recommended to remove the invalid policy, while helping to save the specification.
